clips.title: The story
paras: Harlan Bagley, a Stormwind merchant, cannot keep sturdy clothes and armor in stock. As demand surges, he sends an urgent cloth order to Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, unaware of the conflicts brewing beyond the city walls.

Across Stormwind City, Harlan Bagley's shelves are emptying fast. Citizens and wandering adventurers are buying reinforced tunics, traveling clothes, and battle-ready armor. Harlan wonders if people are preparing for a harsh season or winter, but the rush has left his shop short of finished cloth.

Harlan sends a runner across the city's waterways to Rema Schneider, a seamstress at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. She is glad of his trade, yet the sudden demand for protective clothing troubles her. Rumors of tension spread through the kingdom, and Rema wonders whether the House of Nobles is hiding talk of open war from ordinary people.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We've been doing a lot of business lately. It seems like everyone is buying armor and sturdy clothes. Almost like they expect a cold, harsh season ahead...
But those are future worries. My worry today is that I'm running out of knitted clothing to sell. I need another load from our supplier.
If you can take this request to Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, I'd be most grateful.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You bring word from Mr. Bagley?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It says here that Harlan's business is booming. That's good news, but I wonder why people have need of all that armor. I've heard nothing of open war...is there something the nobles aren't telling us?
Well, thank you for bringing the request. Here's your payment, and I'll see to it that Harlan gets his supplies.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
